XionTech website: UX, accessibility and performance audit

2026-10-16 · localhost:3000 (latest develop, Next.js dev server) · headless Edge via Playwright · EN plus VI spot-check · read-only

Executive summary

8/10persona journey runs succeeded (5 personas x 2 viewports)
21 / 5accessibility test cases pass / fail
0axe-core WCAG 2.2 AA violations across 7 pages
0.000CLS on every page measured; LCP under 0.9 s on dev server

The site is technically solid: every core goal is reachable on desktop and phone, axe reports zero WCAG A/AA violations (contrast included), structure is clean (one h1, landmarks, no heading skips), the contact form has proper labels, an error summary, aria-invalid and focus-to-first-error, and reduced-motion is honoured fully (no running animations, no hidden content, static hero).

The gaps are mostly business, not engineering: there is little proof (case studies, logos, outcomes) next to the CTAs, the contact form doesn't capture company, interest or timeline, product dialogs have no contextual CTA, news stories can't be shared, and careers has a single role with no fallback path. On accessibility, the main failures are focus containment (product dialog, mobile menu), an incomplete Pause motion toggle, and reveal content hidden without JS. Performance-wise, looping animation keeps the phone main thread about 68% busy while idle on home; reduced motion drops it to about 7%.

Goal: Review a product, reach the contact form

Friction

  • Products page lists 3 platforms but the stop dialog is the only place with detail; there is no per-product "Book a demo" or "Talk to us about Parent Hub" CTA, so the contact form arrives without product context (no product/interest field).

axe can't evaluate contrast over images/gradients/WebGL. Spot-check hero text over the 3D background manually. Forced-colors: emulated and screenshotted; review the image for invisible icons/borders.

Performance: normal vs reduced motion

Method: Lighthouse isn't installed in the repo, and the brief didn't allow downloading it, so metrics come from Playwright + PerformanceObserver (FCP, LCP, CLS, TBT = sum of long-task time over 50 ms after FCP) plus CDP Performance.getMetrics for main-thread busy % during 5 s of idle after load. Phone = 390x844, 4x CPU throttle, about 1.6 Mbps / 150 ms. Each page was warmed once (dev compile) and then reloaded.

Dev-server caveat: numbers come from next dev on localhost: unminified bundles, HMR, no CDN, cached reload (transfer KB is unrepresentative). Absolute values are optimistic for latency and pessimistic for JS cost. Use them only to compare normal vs reduced motion, and re-run Lighthouse on a production build or staging before quoting.

Reading: load metrics barely change with reduced motion. The difference is idle CPU: home 32% to 0% (desktop) and 68% to 7% (phone); products 21% to 0% and 49% to 0%. Continuous animations (hero/WebGL, photo strip/carousels) run even when nobody is watching them, which costs battery and responsiveness on phones.

Prioritised recommendations

PriorityEffortAreaRecommendationExpected business impact
HighSCredibilityAdd proof near every CTA: 2-3 case studies (problem, what XionTech built, outcome) and client/school logos, using only facts the team can verify. Services and About currently make promises without evidence.Higher contact-form conversion from CTO/founder traffic; shorter sales cycles.
HighSLead qualityAdd optional "Company", "What do you need help with?" (Services / Parent Hub / Staff Hub / AI Tutor / Other) and "Timeline" fields; pre-select the interest when the CTA comes from a product dialog or service section (pass ?interest=).Qualified leads, faster routing; product-level demand data.
HighSCTA clarityAdd a contextual CTA inside each product stop dialog ("Talk to us about Parent Hub") and at the end of each service section, instead of only the global Let's talk.More product-led enquiries from school decision-makers.
HighMAnalyticsInstrument conversion events: CTA clicks (by location), form start, form error, form submit success, product dialog opens, job apply submit, language switch. No conversion tracking was observed during the audit to verify.Lets the team measure every recommendation here.
HighSAccessibilityFix focus containment in the product dialog (5/15 Tab presses escaped) and the mobile menu (3/20 stops reached content behind the menu). Use inert on the background or a proper focus trap.WCAG 2.4.3 / 2.1.2 compliance; keyboard and screen-reader users can finish P1.
MediumSAccessibilityPause motion leaves 3 looping animations running and the toggle has no aria-pressed state (label swaps to "Play motion"). Stop all infinite animations and expose state.WCAG 2.2.2; also cuts idle CPU (home main thread 32% busy desktop, 68% phone when idle).
MediumMPerformancePause off-screen/looping animations (IntersectionObserver, document.hidden) and defer heavy hero/WebGL work on phones. Reduced-motion mode drops idle main-thread busy from 68% to 7% on phone home: the cost is animation, not content.Battery/thermal on phones, smoother scrolling, better INP.
MediumSContentAdd share buttons (LinkedIn, Facebook, copy link) and a "Next / related stories" block on news stories.More organic reach for company news; longer sessions.
MediumSCareersAdd a general application / talent-pool path and, when only one role is open, say so plainly with an expected hiring cadence.Keeps candidates who don't match the single role.
MediumSNo-JS / resilienceProducts, Careers and News leave 1-7 headings/paragraphs at opacity 0 without JS (reveal animations rely on JS). Default to visible and animate only when JS adds a class.Content survives JS failures, slow devices and some crawlers.
MediumSNavigationGive contact its own URL/page (or keep #contact but return users to their page after submit) so leaving Products/Services for the form doesn't lose context.Lower drop-off between interest and form.
LowSReassuranceNext to Submit, state what happens next (who replies and typical response time, only if the team commits to one) and link the privacy page.Lower form anxiety, fewer abandoned forms.
LowSTouchOne 1x1 px focusable element on phone home (likely a visually-hidden control) is reported as a target under 24 px; confirm it is the skip link or hide it from pointer users.Clean WCAG 2.5.8 result.
LowSNews UXVerify story-card links navigate on first click on desktop (desktop run did not navigate within the wait time on the dev server).Avoids lost readers if it reproduces in production.

Copy suggestions are structural only; no figures, clients or commitments are invented. Fill them with facts the team can verify.

Scope and notes

  • Not flagged by design: 4 locations (2 delivery centres, 2 offices), headquarters/delivery-centre wording, the two vinni.tran emails, the Sanity "XionTechs" news title, the "Start with education" industries section.
  • No form was submitted. The contact form was filled up to Submit; the application form was only reached.
  • Scripts: .working/audit/run.mjs, report.mjs; raw data: .working/audit/results.json.
